proof_artifacts.notes: Mojo proof_partial is a Debian feasibility spike plus Shared script corpus proof and local Reference proof surface: pinned Mojo 1.0.0b1 install, Project-shaped status, libsecp256k1 vectors, RocksDB runtime proof, native-boundary audit, Docker 45/45 script corpus, Docker/local-reference 5k, 50k, 100k, 100k-source-status, and post-100k-to-tip command surfaces. Native libsecp256k1 remains the comparable crypto lane; docker-script-corpus-shadow is diagnostic-only Zig-style comparator output that writes Mojo-local port.script_corpus_shadow_crypto.v1 output and must not be imported as canonical corpus evidence. The pure Mojo backend currently supports BIP340 Schnorr and Taproot tweak primitives through libsecp-guided fixed-limb field multiplication and Jacobian group operations, and pure ECDSA/DER now matches native vector result classes including high-S normalization and malformed DER/pubkey handling. The diagnostic pure-crypto-profile command records ECDSA parse, normalization, inverse, scalar, reference double-base, wNAF double-base, affine conversion, and native-result comparison timings. The measured shadow set now enables all 45 script corpus rows with native-first comparison, zero native fallback, timing fields, and disagreement reporting: all Taproot rows, all P2PKH rows, bare legacy, bare multisig, simple P2SH legacy, and SegWit v0/P2WSH rows. P2PKH shadow rows emit ECDSA sighash, verify, total, and signature-count timing fields. Docker shadow 5k/50k proof targets run native local Reference validation while pure Mojo crypto replays supported corpus families beside it; these artifacts are diagnostic_non_comparable and must not be imported as Project benchmark truth. Shadow replay now reports runner_mode, runner_actual_mode, script_jobs, parallel_batches, and thread_count; a parallel shadow claim requires positive batch evidence. The current Docker 5k diagnostic replay has zero unsupported pure-shadow script inputs and zero disagreements at height 5000. Full pure shadow coverage is still diagnostic-only and does not replace native libsecp256k1 as the comparable proof lane. Shadow artifacts include per-attempt timing, large-fixture size metrics, live-chain supported/unsupported counts, and broader pure shadow coverage requires zero disagreements plus the 5000ms per-row guardrail. Proof paths collect a deterministic block-level script job/result batch; defaults execute sequentially, while MOJOBITNODE_PAR_SCRIPT_VERIFY=1 enables a diagnostic Mojo parallelize runner only when a block has enough script jobs. Proof paths reuse a Mojo-owned native crypto wrapper for long script job batches; native crypto call counts remain in telemetry, while per-call crypto timing is profiling-only via MOJOBITNODE_PROFILE_CRYPTO=1. UTXO deletes, unspent creates, undo, block storage, and metadata are staged into one RocksDB batch commit after verification passes. The debug storage path opens RocksDB with the durable fast-port tuning profile, loads distinct external block prevouts through ordered multi_get, uses Mojo-owned sorted outpoint indexes for block-local lookup, and selects BIP143/Taproot sighash precompute by spent-script family. Generic packed RocksDB batch apply is available for diagnostic profiling with MOJOBITNODE_PACKED_ROCKSDB_BATCH=1, but default proof commits keep the proven WriteBatch primitive path because packed encoding regressed 50k wall time. Project control artifacts remain the source of accepted benchmark truth; the 100k and post-100k-to-tip surfaces are command support until Project accepts canonical artifacts.

known_caveats: Debian bookworm is mandatory for the spike; Ubuntu fallback is intentionally disallowed.
The spike binary owns offline corpus and local Reference 5k/50k proof paths; parallel script verification is diagnostic and env-enabled until Project promotion is explicitly rerun.

Binary gate, external peers, 10k, supervisor, tip-once, and tip-maintenance lanes are not attempted. The 100k and post-100k-to-tip command surfaces exist but require Project campaign acceptance before they become current evidence.
